title: error_envelope
description: Canonical flat error envelope emitted by every audit-plane / admin-plane handler post-MR-!31. Replaces the F001-nested shape. Built by Recurse.Gateway.AuditPlane.ErrorEnvelope.build/3.

error.description: Machine-readable error code (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE prefixed with ERR_).

correlation_id.description: Request correlation ID; defaults to 'unknown' when absent.

attested_run_id.description: When a denial produced an attestation receipt, this is the run_id of that receipt. Null otherwise.
